definitions.full: H1487. gush גּוּשׁ noun [masculine] clod, lump (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic גּוּשָׁה ; compare Arabic etc., rough ground , also ice ) — עָפָר וְגיּשׁ Job 7:5 , Qr ע ׳וְגוּשׁ . גֵּז see below גזז . below גישׁ Job 7:5 Kt, see גּוּשׁ
